name: Readplace
description:
Readplace is a read-it-later app. Save an article now, read it later in a clean reader view, with an AI-assisted tool to help you read more than hoard.

This connector puts that queue in the conversation. Ask Claude to save the sources of a research and it lands in your queue; the title, excerpt, and reader view filled in. Ask what you have saved and Claude lists it, filtered to unread or already read. From any saved item it can pull the details, the cleaned reader text, the  summary, and related articles from your own queue, then mark that item read or unread when you are done.

Nine tools cover saving, browsing, reading, and read state. Only save_link reaches the public internet, and only to fetch the page you asked for; everything else stays inside your own queue.

Connecting is one browser sign-in. OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration means there is no API key to paste, and access is revocable at any time. A Readplace account is required; new accounts start a 14-day free trial with no card. Without an active subscription the account goes read-only, so everything already saved stays readable and exportable and saving new links resumes when the subscription does.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Readplace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Readplace to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://readplace.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Readplace MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Readplace provides these MCP tools: delete_article, get_article, get_article_content, get_article_summary, get_related_articles, list_queue, mark_as_read, mark_as_unread, and save_link.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Readplace?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Readplace in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Readplace requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Readplace is developed by Fayner Brack. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
